DECISION
THE QUESTION
Is this pipeline real?
THE EVIDENCE
Signed MoUs are options, not projects
Most projects fail at feasibility and business plan stage
Even co-developed projects need Finance to see them early
THE DECISION
Measure pipelines by projects that pass both tests, not by MoUs signed.
Developers: expect milestones, sunset clauses and, where appropriate, development securities.
STOP
